name: HubSpot
one_liner: Developer platform for building custom CRM and data-driven website experiences on HubSpot.
auth_notes: OAuth required to distribute to multiple accounts; static auth token (private app) for a single account; both sent as Bearer. A separate developer API key (hapikey) is used only for app-management endpoints. Client-credentials OAuth tokens are used for the webhooks journal.
access_notes: Standard HubSpot accounts can be free; developer test accounts are free (up to 10). Private-distribution OAuth apps are limited to 10 accounts; Marketplace listing is manually reviewed and needs 3 active installs, but is not required to call the API. Some scopes are tiered by plan; rate limits depend on account subscription.

buildability.rationale: Free developer and test accounts, documented REST API, standard OAuth. Caveats: scope tiering by plan, per-plan rate limits, private OAuth apps capped at 10 accounts, and Marketplace review for public distribution.

needs_human_reason: Endpoint count not measured; per-tier rate-limit numbers not captured.
